facts: One of the original 1780 structures, made from limestone quarried nearby. Its parade-facing front and cliff-side porch look over the harbor.
Measured drawings cover the building footprint, all four elevations, and construction details. Arthur Sedlecky and Charles Norton Jr. are credited on the signed federal project sheets.

record: Mackinac State Historic Parks visitor map
facts: The stone quarters sit along the south edge of the parade ground above the harbor.
